units.summary: Adds a package-level test hook invoked before eviction in compactHeadViewLocked. Nil in production, so no runtime effect.

units.summary: Shared helper extracted from the stale-head compaction: captures an append-ID watermark, writes one block per chunk range for a restricted view, reloads, then evicts series and rebuilds the symbol table. Skips empty writes and adds a watermark guard to avoid evicting series with late appends.
units.headline: New shared head-view compaction helper with append-ID eviction watermark
units.reason: Core compaction and eviction logic that can drop data if wrong.
focus: Watermark captured before block write is correct relative to each writer's isolation snapshot
Skipping empty uids no longer logs or reloads for empty slices
Isolation-disabled mode evicts series with concurrent late writes (documented limitation)
Cleanup of blocks on reload failure

units.summary: CompactStaleHead now delegates to compactHeadViewLocked using NewSelectedSeriesHead, truncateStaleSeries with the watermark, and the stale-series hint. Block time bounds now come from view meta (MaxTime+1) instead of StaleHead methods.
units.headline: CompactStaleHead delegates to shared helper with watermark-guarded eviction
units.reason: Changes eviction behavior of an existing production path, adding the append-ID guard.
focus: Block min/max time equals previous StaleHead.MinTime/BlockMaxTime
Stale series with late appends now survive eviction
Metrics and logging still emitted on success
